تزدروا (form VIII)
# تَزْدَرُوا (tazdarū) /taz.da.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
# تُزْدَرَوْا (tuzdaraw) /tuz.da.raw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
